Subject: Post-demo questions on data handling and residency

Hi Chloe —

Thanks for the demo today — Helios enjoyed seeing the latency profile and the console insights. Before we move to a pilot, we need a few commitments in writing around data handling:

- Can Redwood confirm Helios data will not be used to improve or tune any public or internal model variants? We need a written configuration or flag we can reference.
- Can logs and any usage metadata for our account be stored inside the EU (Frankfurt) and retained for 30 days only?
- Are logs encrypted at rest and access-limited to a named list of engineers? We may need a short list of your support/ops access pattern.

Our compliance lead Elena (cc'd) will review the DPA and SOC2 artifacts. If Redwood can provide a clear, short action plan and an addendum we can sign, we can proceed to a 6-week pilot.

Thanks — Samir
Samir Patel

From: chloe martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo questions on data handling and residency

Hi Samir —

Great to chat — glad the demo was useful. Summary + concrete steps below so your legal/compliance team has everything in one place.

TL;DR: We can commit to not using Helios data for model training in the hosted product via an account-level "training_disabled" configuration and a signed addendum. We can also store logs in the EU (Frankfurt) and set retention to 30 days. We will provide SOC2 documentation and a DPA draft for signature.

Details / next steps (what we'll deliver):
1) Training guarantee: we will add an account flag (training_disabled=true) on your tenant that prevents usage of Helios inputs for any model tuning or improvements. We'll also include the provision in a short addendum (attached draft DPA).

2) Data residency & retention: for Hosted accounts we support region selection for logs. We can route Helios logs to our EU region (fra-1) and configure retention to 30 days. If you later need longer retention we can extend, but default will be 30 days as requested.

3) Encryption & access controls: logs are encrypted at rest (AES-256) and access is controlled via RBAC. We will provide a one-page access matrix that lists the Redwood roles that may view anonymized metrics vs. named-support-only exceptions.

4) Evidence: attached is our SOC2 report (redacted) and a privacy checklist for pilots. We'll also share the DPA draft for your legal team to review.

Attachments included: redwood-privacy-checklist.xlsx, data-processing-addendum-v2.pdf, SOC2-report-2025.pdf

Action items (owners & ETA):
- Redwood (Chloe): Add training_disabled flag to Helios tenant and confirm completion via email — ETA 1 business day once we have account ID.
- Redwood Legal (cc via separate thread): Send DocuSign-ready DPA addendum — ETA 1-2 business days.
- Helios (Elena / Legal): Review DPA draft and return redlines or sign.
- Redwood Support: Provide one-page access matrix and confirmation of EU log location — ETA 1 business day.

If that looks good I can loop in our Legal and Support contacts and we can get the DocuSign started. Would you like me to do that now?

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0187
